ability.name: Domain Information and DNS Zone Querying
ability.description: Discovers current domain structure, Domain Controllers, and Active Directory-integrated DNS zones using built-in .NET and ADSI capabilities.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\Windows\Temp\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $domain = [System.DirectoryServices.ActiveDirectory.Domain]::GetCurrentDomain(); Write-Output "Domain: $($domain.Name)"; Write-Output "DCs: $($domain.DomainControllers)"; $root = [ADSI]'LDAP://RootDSE'; $dnsZonePath = 'LDAP://CN=MicrosoftDNS,DC=DomainDnsZones,' + $root.defaultNamingContext; if ([System.DirectoryServices.DirectoryEntry]::Exists($dnsZonePath)) { $entry = [ADSI]$dnsZonePath; foreach ($child in $entry.Children) { if ($child.SchemaClassName -eq 'dnsZone') { Write-Output "DNS Zone: $($child.cn)" } } } else { Write-Output 'No DomainDnsZones found' } } catch { "ERROR: $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d\dns_zones.txt

rationale: Queries basic AD structure and AD-integrated DNS zones to map potential targets dynamically.
